subject: Startups
title: Monthly Recurring Revenue
description: A short lesson to help you apply Monthly Recurring Revenue.

hook.text: Investors ask one question first: what's your MRR? Monthly recurring revenue is the heartbeat of a SaaS startup.

buildup.text: MRR counts only predictable, subscription-based income. One-time payments and services don't count.

discovery.text: A startup doing $100K MRR has $1.2M in annualized revenue. That milestone often triggers Series A conversations.

twist.text: MRR can be misleading if most subscribers churn quickly. High MRR with high churn is a leaky bucket.

climax.text: Track net MRR: new subscriptions minus churned ones. Growth only counts if you're keeping more than you lose.

punchline.text: MRR tells you if your business works every month.
